description: This file is a Markdown document describing the concept of 'Subsystems' within the Thunder framework. It explains how subsystems are abstract categories of functionality managed by plugins, including their states (active/inactive), metadata interfaces, how to mark them as active or inactive, check their status, subscribe to notifications, and how they influence plugin startup order through metadata. The content also provides code snippets in C++ illustrating interaction with the subsystem interfaces.

classes.name: InternetInfo
classes.description: A sample implementation of the IInternet interface used for registering Internet subsystem metadata within a plugin.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: An example implementation of ISubsystem::INotification used to receive updates when subsystem states change.
